Policies and Initiatives.title: Haryana CM launches AI sandbox in Gurugram to accelerate Antyodaya-centric governance
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Haryana's Chief Minister has launched an AI sandbox in Gurugram to accelerate governance focused on Antyodaya, a vision for a Developed India. The initiative will allow government departments to present challenges for innovators to develop and test solutions, driving public welfare and governance through technology. The World Bank will provide assistance in skill development as part of this effort.

Major AI Developments.title: ‘AI platform to connect Parliament, Assemblies’: Haryana Speaker Harvinder Kalyan
Major AI Developments.summary: Haryana Speaker Harvinder Kalyan has announced plans for an AI platform to connect Parliament and state Assemblies. The platform aims to facilitate communication and coordination between these legislative bodies. This initiative is expected to enhance collaboration and information sharing among them.

Major AI Developments.title: Gurugram university hosts global summit on AI & law
Major AI Developments.summary: Gurugram University hosted a two-day international conference on the convergence of artificial intelligence and law, which concluded on Saturday. The conference saw active participation from scholars, experts, researchers, and students from across the country and abroad. The valedictory ceremony was attended by Raj Nehru, OSD to the Chief Minister of Haryana, as the chief guest.

Major AI Developments.title: Haryana real estate body orders Rs 4-crore payout for Chintels Paradiso flat buyer, using Google AI
Major AI Developments.summary: The Haryana real estate body has ordered a payout of Rs 4 crore to a buyer of a Chintels Paradiso flat. This decision was made with the assistance of Google AI technology. The payout is a significant development in the case, highlighting the use of AI in real estate dispute resolution.

Major AI Developments.title: ’13 bombs’ threat: Punjab and Haryana High Court targeted in AI-generated threat mail
Major AI Developments.summary: The Punjab and Haryana High Court received a threat email claiming 13 bombs had been planted in the building. The email was generated using artificial intelligence, according to reports. Authorities are investigating the threat, which has raised security concerns at the court.
